payload.summary: Malware scanner for the ingestion worker is deferred; new uploads and re-index stay blocked until it is built or the gate is changed
payload.detail: Owner decision 27 Oct 2026 (docs/decisions/2026-10-27-defer-worker-malware-scanner.md): defer the scanner because only administrators can upload. Without the module named by WORKER_ADMIN_SOURCE_RUNTIME_MODULE the worker builds an unavailable provider-egress context (worker/provider-egress.ts), so every job is refused before any provider call. Revisit when new uploads are needed: either build the ClamAV module (pinned binary and signature hashes, signatures at most 7 days old, daily refresh) or ask the owner to approve exempting administrator uploads from the scan. Indexing rights per document (rights: permitted) are a separate gate waiting on counsel (#HGEC4B). The #GJHKYC pilot is parked on this.
